definitions.accepted_correct: strict accepted correctness: the assigned local track maps to exactly {target_gt}; a mixed mapping is not strict-correct
definitions.accepted_correct_relaxed: accepted assignment maps to a set containing target_gt, including mixed mappings
definitions.accepted_unresolved: accepted assignment had no posthoc known GT mapping
definitions.ambiguous_identity_mapping: accepted association event whose assigned local track ID causally maps to more than one GT identity
definitions.association_events: valid IoU>=0.5 same-category observation with the GT identity matched by a strictly prior prediction
definitions.false_merge: accepted assignment mapped to a known different GT identity and not to the target
definitions.gap: current annotation frame_id minus the last prior prediction frame mapped to the same GT identity
definitions.positive_events: at least one causal candidate memory ID already mapped posthoc to that GT identity
definitions.prefilter_rank: candidate_prefilter_ranks emitted by the runtime event diagnostic
definitions.qdic_rank: candidate_logit_ranks emitted by the runtime event diagnostic

search_contract.selection_metric: minimum video-disjoint holdout total loss among completed A1/A2 new architectures; final top1/mrr tie-break; A0/A0-D excluded from architecture selection

payload.reason: Bounded sequential search is complete; this proposal is not auto-started.

margin_search.interpretation: Margin champion selection and score search are bounded sequential evidence; they do not establish a global score-by-margin optimum.

score_analysis.note: SCORE_OFF/P03/P05 are interpreted only from their own recorded candidate metrics; no cross-margin score quantile is substituted.

horizon_interpretation.note: G720 gaps above 360 are inference extrapolation outside the learned feature horizon, not a pure memory-horizon effect.
